sources.title: AC 20-115D — Airborne Software Development Assurance Using EUROCAE ED-12( ) and RTCA DO-178( )
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the public FAA advisory circular through its retained public extraction. It describes an acceptable means, rather than a regulation or the only means, for software aspects of type certification or TSO authorization; it names ED-12C/DO-178C and ED-215/DO-330.

regions.locator: PDF p. 1, Purpose; retained extraction lines 13–39
regions.excerpt: This AC describes an acceptable means, but not the only means, for showing compliance

regions.locator: PDF p. 2, document set; retained extraction lines 22–39
regions.excerpt: RTCA DO-330, Software Tool Qualification Considerations

sources.limitations: This public AC recognizes a method as an acceptable means for stated FAA purposes. It is not the licensed DO-178C/DO-330 text and does not establish an ML assurance method, a project certification basis, or an approval.

sources.title: Certification of Safety-Critical Software Under DO-178C
sources.jurisdiction: Public explanation of airborne software assurance
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the retained public NASA text. The paper explains requirements-based and structural coverage, bidirectional traceability, lifecycle/configuration processes, and tool qualification as its account of the DO-178C approach.

regions.locator: pp. 4–6, verification philosophy; retained extraction lines 140–154
pp. 6–9, traceability, lifecycle and tools; retained extraction lines 192–215 and 278–284

sources.limitations: This is NASA's public explanatory paper, not the licensed standard. It supports a manager-level characterization only; readers must not treat it as clause-level text or a current FAA approval for an ML component.

sources.title: AC 20-174 — Development of Civil Aircraft and Systems
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the official public FAA page and document description. It says AC 20-174 recognizes ARP4754A as an acceptable method for establishing a development-assurance process, including requirements validation and design-implementation verification.

regions.excerpt: recognizes ... ARP 4754A ... as an acceptable method for establishing a development assurance process

sources.limitations: The source recognizes ARP4754A, not ARP4754B, and does not provide the licensed standard's contents. It is used only to describe the public FAA system-development-assurance framing.

sources.title: ISO 26262 road-vehicle functional-safety collection
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected ISO's public collection page and public abstract. They list management, concept, system, hardware, software, production/operation, supporting-process and ASIL-oriented-analysis parts of ISO 26262.

regions.locator: ISO public collection page, included parts
regions.excerpt: Product development at the system level ... Product development at the software level ... Automotive safety integrity level (ASIL)-oriented

sources.limitations: The public page shows scope and document-part names only. It is not the licensed ISO 26262 text and cannot establish clause-level obligations, a vehicle's conformance, or aviation applicability.

sources.title: HWY18MH010 — Collision Between Vehicle Controlled by Developmental Automated Driving System and Pedestrian
sources.jurisdiction: Tempe, Arizona, US road automated-driving-system testing
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected NTSB's completed-investigation page and its summary of ADS detection timing, probable cause and contributing factors. The final board report is the source for the limited walkthrough point; no reconstruction beyond the stated findings is made.

regions.locator: NTSB investigation page, What Happened / What We Found
regions.excerpt: The ADS detected the pedestrian 5.6 seconds before impact.

regions.locator: NTSB investigation page, probable cause / contributing factors

sources.limitations: The NTSB findings concern this 2018 crash and testing operation. They do not establish the behavior, evidence, or safety of another vehicle, model, company, or current regulatory regime.
